name: sauriopdf
description: High-performance PDF generation for Deno, Node.js, Bun, and browsers — powered by Rust/WASM (Krilla)

scripts.build:wasm: cd rust-core && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sauriopdf_core.wasm --out-dir ../wasm --target web
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts

author: SaurioPDF Contributors
